request.style: English, female soulful jazz voice, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, saxophone, warm nostalgic mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Thomas spoke up in the room of light
Lord we do not know where you go
How can we find the road tonight
When the path is hidden and low
You know the place you will prepare
A room for us to finally stay
But how can we find you there
If we do not know the way

[Chorus]
I am the way and the truth and the life
No one comes to the Father except through me
I am the way and the truth and the life
No one comes to the Father except through me

[Verse]
Philip asked to see the face of God
Show us the Father that is enough
Jesus looked at him with a nod
I have been with you in this rough
Whoever has seen me has seen the Father
How can you ask to be shown
You have looked into my face so rather
Than a stranger and alone
If you had known me you would know him
From now on you do know him well
You have seen him in this moment
And in my words you dwell

[Chorus]
I am the way and the truth and the life
No one comes to the Father except through me
I am the way and the truth and the life
No one comes to the Father except through me

[Bridge]
Where I am you may be also
Come back and take you to myself
The place is ready in the bosom
Of the Father in the shelf
You know the way to the place where I go
Though you say you do not know
I am the road you do not see
Only in my face you know

[Chorus]
I am the way and the truth and the life
No one comes to the Father except through me
I am the way and the truth and the life
No one comes to the Father except through me

[Outro]
I am the way and the truth and the life
No one comes to the Father except through me
